product.description: Poirot a fost de față când Jane s-a lăudat că are un plan prin care să scape de soțul de care se înstrăinase. Acum monstruosul bărbat este mort. Și totuși, micuțul detectiv nu poate să nu simtă că este dus de nas. La urma urmelor, cum ar fi putut Jane să-l înjunghie pe lordul Edgware în biblioteca lui exact în același moment în care se afla la cină cu niște prieteni? Și care i-ar fi motivul, acum că aristocratul a fost în cele din urmă de acord să-i acorde divorțul? Iată un alt caz care va pune la încercare toate abilitățile de fin detectiv ale lui Poirot.

# 13 la Cina by Litera: A Classic Mystery Featuring Hercule Poirot

## Unraveling Suspicion in *13 la Cina*

Dive back into the world of classic detective fiction with **13 la Cina** (13 at Dinner), a compelling mystery novel from the acclaimed brand, Litera. This captivating story promises readers an intriguing case that will test even the sharpest observational skills. For fans who adore the intellectual puzzle-solving of Hercule Poirot, this book offers a fresh and challenging whodunit.

The plot centers around a seemingly perfect evening that unravels into deadly complexity. As featured in the description, Poirot is confronted with Jane, who has boasted about her plan to escape her husbandâa man now tragically deceased. Despite the apparent end of danger, the meticulous detective senses something amiss. How could Jane have fatally stabbed Lord Edgware in his own library at the exact moment she was having dinner with friends? And what motive could there be now that the aristocrat has agreed to grant her a divorce?

This is another masterful case designed to challenge all of Poirot's renowned abilities, making it an essential read for mystery enthusiasts.

***

## Why Choose *13 la Cina*?

Whether you are new to Hercule Poirot or a long-time fan, this book delivers the perfect blend of suspense, witty dialogue, and clever deduction. The narrative keeps the reader guessing right up until the final page, making it an ideal choice for a relaxing but thrilling reading experience. Discover the secrets hidden beneath the surface during this unforgettable dinner party mystery.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this a standalone Poirot mystery?**
A: While it features Hercule Poirot's investigation skills, the book stands alone and provides a complete, self-contained mystery experience.

**Q: Who is the ideal reader for this book?**
A: This novel is perfect for fans of classic whodunit mysteries, puzzle fiction, and readers who enjoy detailed detective work in their literature.
